reviews.summary: Match 15 won a four-player public game but ended after three accepted answers, with only one deep cut. Full next-match recording retained; a longer winning match is still needed for the featured deep-cut footage.
changes: Once a local pool has server-confirmed common answers and no rare alternatives, generate rare alternatives in the background while local answers stay immediately usable.

reviews.summary: Match 16 won a six-player public game with 10 accepted answers, no rejections, three rare answers and one deep cut. One pop followed exhaustion of the finite nuclear-weapons country category. Retained its full recording; the featured match still needs multiple deep cuts.
changes: Retained confirmed answers for the 7.29-second fresh nuclear-weapons category.
Strengthened the generation preference toward niche but conventional deep-cut choices while requiring certain category fit.

reviews.summary: Match 17 won a five-player public game with 45 accepted answers, one miss, five hearts, 23 deep cuts and four krillion answers. Category 6 boxing movies is the sole requested README clip: two krillion and three deep-cut answers.
changes: Retained verified rarity and retired the rejected New York City landmark guess.

Reviewed why local work words stayed common: used accepted answers must still count when deciding whether the local pool has already shown common-only results. Corrected the background-refill gate and regression scenario.

reviews.summary: Match 18 won a six-player public game with 19 accepted answers, no rejections, four hearts and no pops. Every answer was rare or better: 15 deep cuts, three rare and one krillion. None of its seven prompts was in the new regular-game index, so this match validates fallback play, not live regular-bank agreement.
changes: Retained the newly server-confirmed rare answers for seven categories.
Added an optional public daily/free-preview index: 42 prompts, 2710 retained choices, provenance kept separate from Puffer acknowledgement tiers.
Verified 54 matching historical Puffer answers had identical regular-game tiers. Isolated index lookup median 0.412ms, p95 2.476ms with zero model requests.
Raised the group campaign watchdog to 30 minutes because the previous 13-category rare-answer match already lasted over eight minutes; avoid abandoning a valid long game at ten minutes.

reviews.summary: Reviewed public six-player HMKJ win: 26/26 accepted, 8 krillion, 16 deepcut, 2 schooler, five hearts; archive covered 7/9 categories and all 21 archive predictions matched the game. Four fresh Codex requests served the two uncovered categories. Retained newly confirmed answers and reduced eager model refill while three useful local rare choices remain.
changes: Preserved actual Puffer acknowledgements and rarity for all new answers.
Deferred long fallback refill after an initial three-answer burst until fewer than three useful choices remain; meaningful regression updated.
All 61 tests pass. Five-game cohort report now contains game 1 of 5; remaining outcomes will be retained.
